title: cassia tora var. obtusifolia
intro: Cassia tora var. obtusifolia, commonly known as Indian senna or chakramarda, is a plant species that belongs to the family Fabaceae. It is traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine to treat various health conditions, including constipation, diarrhea, and inflammatory diseases, due to its health benefits in promoting digestive health and reducing inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Cassia tora var. obtusifolia include its ability to act as a laxative, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial agent, making it a potential remedy for various health issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and are responsible for its therapeutic actions.
